decisions.statement: No call names the kind of change landed here.
The tracked trees are Alan's days and his food entries.
A path outside the tracked trees is refused.
The change a call asks for is read by `file-arguing` and landed by `track-landing`.
The function this command calls knows no command line.
The kind named here runs no warrant.
No reading is owed for a path landed here.
The kind landed here is mechanical.
No check judges the change landed here.
Every flag `file-arguing` takes is taken here but the glass and `--restated`.
One call names one `--file-path` and one `--content-file`, and several files take several calls.
Nothing here reaches a path an agent chose.
A run that wrote before it threw says in its refusal what that run had written.
A fault carries the code that fault names and says where it was thrown.

definition: the command landing the pages and row files of Alan's tracking that a program composed
